final: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_driver_laps FROM driver_totals
